products.label: Products
products.title: Our first product

medassistant.title: Software for healthcare clinics
medassistant.description: medassistant gives doctors and clinic managers control of their operation — billing patients, generating invoices, managing payments, and following up on appointments and patients, all in one place.

products.more: More products, built on the same system, are on the way.

hero.subtitle: The software that would allow you to manage your clinic and make intelligent decisions. All integrated, all simple.
hero.imageAlt: Doctor using tablet in a modern and bright clinic

preview.title: Your Medical Ecosystem, Unified and Intelligent
preview.description: An interface designed for humans, powered by data. Visualize everything that matters at a glance.

visitSummaries.title: Automated Visit Summaries
visitSummaries.description: Instantly send a complete visit summary to your patient's email after the consultation. Improve patient adherence and keep them informed with a single click.

profileAccess.title: Instant Profile Access
profileAccess.description: Specific patient details are just a keystroke away. Access full history, allergies, and notes in seconds without digging through physical files.

paymentManagement.title: Flexible Payment Management
paymentManagement.description: Handle clinic finances with ease. Record full or partial payments, track outstanding balances, and manage invoices directly within the patient's file.
